name: Background invoicing
summary: Billing that runs on your schedule.
description: A background processing system that turns contract rules and billing cadences into automated invoice workflows.
technologies: .NET 8 / .NET 9, EF Core, background workers, SQL Server
challenge: Daily, weekly, biweekly, and monthly schedules need consistent validation and clear data access paths.
approach: Separate cadence rules from job execution, validate services before invoice generation, and use explicit database projections to retrieve the required data.
imageAlt: Workflow diagram showing billing cadence and invoice batch validation and processing
